name: Syncthing
description: Continuously syncs folders between your devices — no cloud.
compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    container_name: syncthing
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8384"
      - "22000:22000"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}:/var/syncthing
